questions.q: Choose the correct article: “I need ____ umbrella.”
questions.why: 'Umbrella' starts with a vowel sound. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct question tag: “You are a doctor, ____?”
questions.why: Positive statement takes a negative tag with the same auxiliary. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the meaning of the idiom “to turn a blind eye”:
Fill in the blank: “May God ____ you with a long life!”
questions.why: 'May' expressing a wish takes the bare infinitive. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to “expand”:
questions.why: To expand is to enlarge; to contract is to shrink. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “The police ____ investigating the case.”
questions.why: 'Police' is always plural. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct modal: “______ I come in, sir?”
questions.why: 'May' for polite permission. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Identify the error: “One of my friend has joined the health department.”
questions.why: 'One of' takes a plural noun: 'one of my friends'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Select the simple past tense of the verb ‘to be’: “The road ____ long and lonely.”
questions.why: Simple past of 'be' with a singular subject is 'was'. (The paper printed 'to have'; the answer key is 'was'.) GPSC CBRT, Feb 2024.

questions.q: Find the error: “The list of approved candidates are displayed on the notice board.”
questions.why: The subject is 'list' (singular): 'is displayed'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
